sources.title: Supergirl S01E19 Myriad recap - ew.com
sources.verification: Non and Indigo activate Myriad mind-control device via Maxwell Lord's hijacked satellites. Entire National City becomes drones. Kara, Cat, and Max unaffected (Max invented ion blocker, sent Cat earrings). Non forces James, Winn, and receptionist to jump from balcony - Kara saves only James and Winn. Max proposes Kryptonite bomb (kills all Kryptonians + ~8% humans). Alura hologram explains Myriad was created by Astra and Non, banned by High Council. Alex and J'onn on the run, go back to National City, Indigo stabs J'onn, Alex falls under Myriad. Cliffhanger: Alex in Kryptonite suit with Kryptonite sword vs Kara.

sources.title: Supergirl S01E19 Myriad - mtrnetwork, scifipulse, joblo, projectfandom
sources.verification: Myriad is Astra and Non's creation. Superman also affected (human brain more susceptible). Non's plan: use combined brainpower of all humans as supercomputer. Indigo manipulating Non for galaxy-domination goals. Bomb would make National City uninhabitable for Kryptonians for 50 years. Alex's determination to go back is character-consistent. Hank/J'onn disguised on bus to Midvale, stop at Eliza's house.

beats.description: Non and Indigo activate Myriad mind-control device via Maxwell Lord's hijacked satellites
Entire National City becomes drones - people walk and act in rhythm
Kara at CatCo sees Winn, James, and receptionist typing in rhythm
Fortress of Solitude - Alura hologram explains Myriad was created by Astra and Non to unite minds, banned by High Council
Cat arrives at CatCo unaffected - wearing ion-blocker earrings from Max
Max arrives unaffected - ion blocker, satellites hijacked
Non forces James, Winn, and receptionist onto balcony - Kara saves James and Winn, receptionist falls
Max proposes Kryptonite bomb plan - would kill all Kryptonians and ~8% of humans
Cat advises hope over fear - hope is the counter to Myriad
Alex and J'onn return to National City - Indigo stabs J'onn, Alex falls under Myriad
Cliffhanger: Alex in Kryptonite suit with Kryptonite sword vs Kara
Superman also affected - raised on Earth, human brain more susceptible
Non's plan: use combined brainpower of all humans as a supercomputer
Indigo is manipulating Non for her own galaxy-domination goals
Bomb would make National City uninhabitable for Kryptonians for 50 years
Hank/J'onn disguised on a bus to Midvale, stop at Eliza's house
